head: codex/5866-distributed-discovery
title: [v0.92][WP-04.04] Bounded authenticated seed discovery
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5866

## Summary

- treat configured seeds only as bounded addresses and expected peer identities, never as enrollment or membership authority
- bind authenticated transport envelopes to live enrolled node, Guardian, identity, and transport-certificate generations
- emit deterministic domain-separated non-voting JoinProposal values and revalidate candidate enrollment after every network await
- atomically retain accepted request and proposal identifiers across valid seeds so cross-seed replay fails closed
- retain live replay entries through signed expiry, deny full live windows, and recover bounded capacity only after trusted expiry
- leave discovery intentionally unregistered until issue #5878 owns distributed module integration

## Validation

- exact distributed_discovery nextest target: 12 passed, 0 failed
- real mutual-TLS Quinn/rustls discovery round trip: passed
- cross-seed request replay, live-window exhaustion, and post-expiry capacity recovery: passed
- qualified strict focused Clippy: passed with only the pre-existing ACIP baseline lint allowed
- exact v3 two-revision replay-window proof receipt: passed
- independent exact-head security/correctness review: passed with no findings

## Boundary

This child owns only adl-runtime/src/distributed/discovery.rs and adl-runtime/tests/distributed_discovery.rs plus its typed lifecycle/evidence. Module registration remains exclusively owned by #5878.
